privacy.heading: Privacy
privacy.analyticsDescription: Helps us understand how the app is used, so we can improve it. Never includes password, email or the content of your tasks/sessions. Details in the <0>Privacy Policy</0>.

wipeGuestData.heading: Erase my data on this device
wipeGuestData.description: You're using Guardião Pomodoro without an account: tasks, sessions and achievements are saved only in this browser. Erasing the data on this device removes them forever — there's no way to recover them afterwards. It's also how you switch to another person on this device, for example to lend it to someone to use the app from scratch (the same shortcut is available in the avatar menu, at the top of the screen).
wipeGuestData.button: Erase my data on this device
wipeGuestData.confirmTitle: Erase all data on this device?
wipeGuestData.confirmBody: This action can't be undone. Tasks, sessions and achievements saved in this browser will be permanently erased.

deleteAccount.heading: Delete account
deleteAccount.description: Removes your account and all your history (sessions, tasks, achievements) forever. This action can't be undone.
deleteAccount.passwordLabel: Confirm your password to delete the account
deleteAccount.genericError: Couldn't delete the account. Please try again.
